chunks: And in another report: “A mudd of food or two handfuls.”
And it is preferable that the muhrim does not scratch his head except with gentle scratching, using the tips of the fingers.

key_terms.الْأَصَابِعِ: the fingers, specifically their tips here
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: the person in the state of ihram
key_terms.مُدًّا: a mudd, a measured quantity of food used in legal rulings

ai.seo_question: What is the preferred way for a muhrim to scratch the head, and what compensation is mentioned in another report?
ai.summary: This text mentions an alternative report specifying a compensation of a mudd of food or two handfuls. It also states the preferred etiquette for the person in ihram: not to scratch the head except gently with the fingertips.
